segments.name: Digital advertising
segments.description: Operates an AI-based digital marketing and media monetization platform that matches advertising campaigns to specific ad spots for brand and direct response advertisers.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as a single operating and reportable segment; accordingly, the adoption resulted in enhanced disclosures but did not change the Company's segment reporting structure.

revenueModel.text: Advertisers pay the company for optimized ad campaign placements matched to ad spots via its AI-driven Eva Platform.
revenueModel.evidence: We execute our business through the Eva Platform based on Artificial Intelligence, or AI, to match advertising campaigns to specific ad spots one at a time.

changes.text: In 2021, the company merged into EvaMedia Corp., shifting from entertainment and publishing to digital marketing and media monetization.
changes.evidence: On September 28, 2021 (the "Acquisition Date"), the Company merged into EvaMedia Corp. ("EvaMedia").
